name: Broken Relationships
overview: Scripture reveals that brokenness of spirit and heart is not despised by God but valued as a true sacrifice, demonstrating humility before Him. God promises healing for those who are broken in heart, tenderly binding up their wounds. Furthermore, He works all things together for good for those who love Him and are called according to His purpose, offering hope amid relational fractures. In the context of family relationships, believers are instructed to nurture and admonish with care, avoiding provoking others to anger, reflecting God’s restorative design for broken relationships.
